fields.name: title

buttons.script:

end mouseUp

buttons.name: Graveyard
buttons.sentence: Clicking this says the Graveyard is not ready yet.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "The Graveyard is still being summoned..."
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Witch's Kitchen
buttons.sentence: Clicking this says the Witch's Kitchen is not ready yet.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp

buttons.name: Pumpkin Patch
buttons.sentence: Clicking this says the Pumpkin Patch is not ready yet.

buttons.name: New Stack
buttons.sentence: Clicking this tells you what is coming.
buttons.script:

cards.name: Gate
cards.script:
on openCard
  put "The old gate creaks in the wind." into field "sign"
end openCard

fields.name: sign
fields.text: The old gate creaks in the wind.

buttons.name: Ring the bell
buttons.sentence: Clicking this rings the bell and asks who is there. If it is a ghost, a werewolf howls back.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "Ding dong! Who's there?" with "A ghost" or "Nobody"
  if it is "A ghost" then
    howl
    put "Something howled back." into field "sign"
  else
    put "Nobody answered." into field "sign"
    put " Or did they?" after field "sign"
  end if
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Enter
buttons.sentence: Clicking this opens the gate and goes to the next card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect iris open
  go to next card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Home
buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes back to the Home stack.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to stack "Home"
end mouseUp

fields.name: greeting
fields.text: A candle flickers in the hall.

fields.name: note
fields.text: Something fluttered out of the closet!

buttons.name: Light a candle
buttons.sentence: Clicking this asks your name and writes a welcome for you.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  global visitor
  ask "What is your name, visitor?"
  put it into visitor
  put "Welcome," && visitor & "." into field "greeting"
  if visitor contains "Kiro" then answer "Oh! A friend of the house."
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Open the closet
buttons.sentence: Clicking this lets a bat out of the closet and shows a note for two seconds.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  release bat
  show field "note"
  wait 2 seconds
  hide field "note"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Upstairs
buttons.sentence: Clicking this wipes to the card named Attic.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect wipe left
  go to card "Attic"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Go deeper
buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes to the next card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to card 1
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Back
buttons.sentence: Clicking this wipes back to the previous card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect wipe right
  go to prev card
end mouseUp

fields.name: label
fields.text: Candles counted:

buttons.name: Count a candle
buttons.sentence: Clicking this counts one more candle. On the fourth and fifth, a witch flies by.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  put field "count" + 1 into field "count"
  if field "count" > 3 and field "count" < 6 then summon witch
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Look up
buttons.sentence: Clicking this drops a spider and makes the label shriek.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  drop spider
  put "Eek! " before field "label"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Down
buttons.sentence: Clicking this wipes back to the previous card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect wipe right
  go to prev card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: To the garden
buttons.sentence: Clicking this dissolves to the last card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect dissolve
  go to last card
end mouseUp

cards.name: Garden
cards.script:
on openCard
  hide button "Dig"
  wait 1 second
  put "The moon is out. Something is watching." into field "msg"
end openCard

fields.name: msg
fields.text: The moon is out. The garden is quiet.

buttons.name: Look at the moon
buttons.sentence: Clicking this makes something glint in the soil and shows the Dig button.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  if not (field "msg" contains "glint") then
    put "Something glints in the soil." into field "msg"
    show button "Dig"
  end if
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Dig
buttons.sentence: Clicking this digs up a seed and asks what to do with it.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "You found a pumpkin seed!" with "Keep it" or "Plant it"
  put "You chose: " & it into field "msg"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Back
buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes to the previous card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to prev card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Start over
buttons.sentence: Clicking this closes with an iris and goes to the first card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect iris close
  go to first card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Home
buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes back to the Home stack.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to stack "Home"
end mouseUp

fields.name: title
fields.text: It's alive!

fields.name: body
fields.text:
Welcome to Stack Séance, HyperCard back from the dead.

Every button here was written from one plain sentence. Flip any card over and you see that sentence next to the script it became. The script is what really runs, and you can change it.

buttons.name: Show me around
buttons.sentence: Clicking this starts the tour on the next card.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  visual effect iris open
  go to next card
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Home
buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes back to the Home stack.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  go to stack "Home"
end mouseUp

fields.name: heading
fields.text: Getting around

fields.name: body
fields.text:
Click a button to run its script. A button can take you to another card, ask you something, or let something out of the closet.

The Go menu at the top goes to the first, previous, next or last card of a stack, and Home. These buttons do the same:

buttons.sentence: Clicking this goes to the first card of this stack.

fields.name: heading
fields.text: Flip the card

fields.name: body
fields.text:
Every card has a back. Click the folded corner at the bottom right, or View › Flip, to turn it over.

The back shows each button's sentence and its HyperTalk script. Change a script and the button changes at once.

Try it: flip this card, change "Hello!" in Say hello, flip back and click it.

fields.name: heading
fields.text: When something breaks

fields.name: body
fields.text:
When a script goes wrong, a note pops up at the bottom of the card, naming the script and the line.

Click the note and the card flips over to that line, lit up, so you can see what went wrong and fix it.

This button is broken on purpose. Click it, then click the note.

fields.name: heading
fields.text: HyperTalk, part 1

fields.name: body
fields.text:
go to next card
visual effect dissolve
answer "Hi" with "A" or "B"
ask "Your name?"
put "text" into field "out"
hide field "out"
wait 1 second

fields.name: out
fields.text: Results show up here.

buttons.name: Try answer
buttons.sentence: Clicking this asks what to do with the monster and writes down the choice.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  answer "It's alive!" with "Run" or "Hug it"
  put "You chose: " & it into field "out"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Try ask
buttons.sentence: Clicking this asks for a name for the monster.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  ask "What should we call the monster?"
  put "Hello," && it & "!" into field "out"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Try put
buttons.sentence: Clicking this writes Zap! in front of the result.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  put "Zap! " before field "out"
end mouseUp

buttons.name: Try hide and show
buttons.sentence: Clicking this hides the result for a second.
buttons.script:
on mouseUp
  hide field "out"
  wait 1 second
  show field "out"
end mouseUp

buttons.sentence: Clicking this opens this card again with an iris.

on mouseUp
  visual effect iris open
  go to card "HyperTalk 1"

fields.name: heading
fields.text: Saves and settings

fields.name: body
fields.text:
File › Saves keeps three copies of every stack in this browser. Export a save to a file to keep it or take it to another computer, and import it back.

File › Settings: day or night, pixel or plain font, bigger text on the back of the card, and Revert to original for when a script is broken beyond repair.
